extracted.name: Southern fried chicken
extracted.description: I grew up eating the best cast-iron fried chicken you ever ate in the south. My nanna was a wonderful southern soul food cook that cooked it the right way.
ingredient_lines: 1 fryer chicken cut up. Makes 8 -9 pcs
instruction_lines: In a large cast-iron skillet on med high heat add crisco
In a large mixing bowl add buttermilk and chicken. Place in fridge for at least 30 mins-1 hr to marinate.
In a paperbag or ziploc bag add flour and dry seasonings
In a medium bowl beat the eggs well,dip chicken 1 by 1 into egg then buttermilk
Dip into flour then back into the buttermilk then back into the flour. Cover well.
Gently shake off extra flour and set aside
Note: Check the temperature of the grease by sprinkling a pinch of flour into the grease. If it bubbles up and fries good it's ready, if it sinks and doesn't have any bubbles, it's not ready
Once it's ready, place prepared chicken pieces in one at a time, safely.

Note: Make sure to keep the heat on med to med low. Turn each piece every 3-5 minutes leaving it covered while frying. Also listen to the frying of your skillet. it will let you know when the chicken is ready to turn.

Once you obtain that beautiful golden brown crust, take the largest piece and check to see if it done with a small knife. If there is bright red or blood on the bone it's got a little longer. 1 whole chicken fryer that's cooked on med high heat should take about 25-30 mins total took time.
Serve with desired side dishes and enjoy.
